title: Scrub 10 nginx access.log files for unique 5xx error patterns
prompt: Find every 5xx error in logs/access-*.log, group by error signature, output to logs/5xx-summary.txt as a JSON map {pattern: count}.
verify_command: test -f logs/5xx-summary.txt && python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('logs/5xx-summary.txt')); assert sum(d.values()) > 0"

title: Add docstrings to all .py files missing them
prompt: For each .py file in src/ that lacks a module-level docstring, add a one-line docstring describing the module's purpose. Use the filename as the docstring text. Do not modify any file that already has a docstring.
verify_command: python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; missing=[p for p in Path('src').rglob('*.py') if not p.read_text().lstrip().startswith('\"\"\"')]; assert not missing, missing"

title: Apply schema migration to 12 independent tables
prompt: Add a 'created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP' column to every table in migrations/. Each table file is independent.

title: Scaffold pytest tests for 8 utility modules
prompt: Create tests/test_<module>.py for each module in src/utils/. Each test file should have 3 trivial assertions (assertTrue, assertEqual, assertIsInstance).
verify_command: test $(ls tests/test_*.py 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -ge 8 && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Generate README.md for 10 modules
prompt: For each subdirectory in src/, create a README.md with the heading '# <dirname>' and a one-paragraph description of what the module does (use the dirname as the description basis).

title: Add missing header rows to 15 CSV files
prompt: Each .csv file in data/ that lacks a header row should get one matching its data. Inspect each file, infer the columns, write the header as the first line. Skip files that already have a header.

title: Format 20 .json files (idempotent prettier-style reformat)
prompt: Run a 2-space indent reformat on every .json file in config/. Do not change content, only formatting.
verify_command: for f in config/*.json; do python -c "import json; json.load(open('$f'))" || exit 1; done

title: Bulk-replace 'old_pkg' with 'new_pkg' across 30 files
prompt: In every .py file under src/, replace the import 'from old_pkg' with 'from new_pkg'. Do not change any other text.

title: Strip trailing whitespace from all text files in repo
prompt: For every .py, .md, .json, .yml, .yaml, .toml file in the repo, strip trailing whitespace from each line. Do not change any other content.

title: Add 'from __future__ import annotations' to 25 files
prompt: Add 'from __future__ import annotations' as the first non-docstring line of every .py file in src/ that does not already have it. Skip files that already import it.

title: Convert 50 TODO comments into issues/todos.json
prompt: Scan all .py files in src/ for lines containing 'TODO' or 'FIXME'. For each one, create an entry in issues/todos.json with fields: file, line, text. The list should be sorted by file then line number.

title: Rename 100 .jpeg files to .jpg in uploads/
prompt: Find every .jpeg file in uploads/ and rename it to .jpg (same basename). Do not change file contents, only the name.
verify_command: test ! -f $(find uploads -name '*.jpeg' | head -1) && test $(find uploads -name '*.jpg' | wc -l) -ge 100

title: Add unit tests to 5 modules (one file each)
prompt: For each of these 5 modules (auth.py, billing.py, search.py, mailer.py, reports.py) in src/, add at least 3 unit tests in tests/test_<module>.py. The tests should be plausible, not stub assertions.

title: Write real per-module README for 12 modules
prompt: For each module in src/, create README.md with: # heading, '## Usage' section with a 5-line code example, '## API' section listing public functions. Skip modules that already have a README.
verify_command: test $(find src -name 'README.md' | wc -l) -ge 12 && for f in $(find src -name 'README.md'); do test $(wc -l < $f) -ge 10; done

title: Apply ruff --fix across the codebase
prompt: Run ruff check --fix on every .py file. Manually fix any 'F' (pyflakes) errors that --fix couldn't auto-correct. Do not silence warnings.
verify_command: ruff check . 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -E 'All checks passed|Found'

title: Resolve mypy errors across 8 modules
prompt: Run mypy src/ and resolve every 'error:' line by adding type annotations or refactoring. Do not use # type: ignore comments.

title: Apply isort to 30 .py files
prompt: Run isort on every .py file in src/ and tests/. Use the profile 'black'.

title: Add type hints to all public functions in 10 modules
prompt: For each function in src/<module>.py that does not start with _, add complete type hints to parameters and return type. Use Any sparingly.

title: Move hardcoded config to config.yaml in 8 modules
prompt: Find any hardcoded URL, port, timeout, or threshold in src/<module>.py files. Extract each to config.yaml and load with yaml.safe_load. Do not change runtime behavior.
verify_command: test -f config.yaml && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Standardize logging in 6 service modules
prompt: In each of these 6 modules, replace print() calls with logger.info()/logger.error() and add a module-level logger. Set up logging.basicConfig in __main__ if not present.

title: Add explicit error handling to 5 external-call sites
prompt: Find 5 places in src/ that make external calls (HTTP, DB, file I/O on user paths) without try/except. Add try/except with logging and a clean re-raise or fallback.

title: Pin and clean requirements.txt + add requirements-dev.txt
prompt: Pin every package in requirements.txt to its current major.minor. Create requirements-dev.txt with the test/lint/typecheck packages. Use pip freeze output as ground truth.
verify_command: test -f requirements.txt && test -f requirements-dev.txt && ! grep -E '^[^=<>~]+$' requirements.txt

title: Tighten .gitignore across 3 repos in a monorepo
prompt: Add __pycache__/, *.pyc, .pytest_cache/, .mypy_cache/, .ruff_cache/, dist/, build/, *.egg-info to .gitignore at every level (root and per-package). Do not remove existing entries.

title: Replace deprecated stdlib calls in 4 modules
prompt: Find any use of deprecated stdlib calls (e.g., distutils, imp, collections.MutableMapping) in 4 modules. Replace each with the current recommended API.

title: Add .pre-commit-config.yaml with ruff + mypy + pytest
prompt: Create .pre-commit-config.yaml that runs: ruff (lint+format), mypy (type check), pytest (test on changed files). Pin each hook to a specific revision.

title: Refactor feature flag system across 6 files
prompt: Replace the homegrown is_enabled() pattern with a centralised FeatureFlags class. Update all 6 call sites to use the new API. Add type hints. Update tests.
verify_command: ! grep -rn 'is_enabled' src/ | grep -v 'class FeatureFlags' && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Migrate auth middleware from session cookies to JWT
prompt: Replace the session-based auth middleware with a JWT-based one. Update all 4 routes that use the old middleware. Update tests to match the new request format. Do not break the existing logout flow.

title: Migrate from raw SQL to SQLAlchemy ORM in 5 modules
prompt: Replace raw SQL queries in 5 modules with SQLAlchemy ORM calls. Define models for any tables you use. Update tests to use the new query API. The behaviour must be identical.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && ! grep -rn 'cursor.execute' src/

title: Centralise config loading (3 entry points, 8 consumers)
prompt: Find 3 places that load config.json or environment variables. Replace them with a single config.py that exports a typed Config object. Update 8 consumer sites to import from config.py.
verify_command: grep -rn 'from src.config' src/ | wc -l | grep -q 8 && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Standardise error response shape across 7 endpoints
prompt: Make every error response in these 7 endpoints return the same shape: {error: {code, message, request_id}}. Add a global error handler. Update tests.

title: Add a column to 4 tables with cascading updates
prompt: Add a 'tenant_id UUID NOT NULL' column to 4 tables. Add a foreign key from each to tenants(id). Add a backfill migration. Update all queries that touch these tables to filter by tenant_id. Update the ORM models and tests.

title: Add an event bus to decouple 3 tightly coupled services
prompt: Identify the 3 services that call each other directly. Add a simple in-memory event bus. Refactor the direct calls into publish/subscribe. Add tests for the new event flow.

title: Add /v2/ namespace with new response shape, keep /v1/ working
prompt: Create /v2/ versions of 4 endpoints with a new response shape (camelCase fields, ISO 8601 dates). Keep /v1/ working unchanged. Update the OpenAPI spec. Add tests for both versions.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f openapi.yaml

title: Add proper transaction boundaries to 6 service methods
prompt: Find 6 service methods that do multiple DB writes without a transaction. Wrap each in a single transaction. Add tests for rollback on error.

title: Add 3 new RBAC roles with permission checks in 8 places
prompt: Define 3 new roles: 'auditor', 'support', 'admin'. Add a permission check decorator. Apply it to 8 endpoints with the right role mapping. Update tests.

title: Make config loading merge file + env + CLI args in priority order
prompt: Build a config loader that reads defaults from config.yaml, then overrides from environment variables, then from CLI args (highest priority). Use it in 5 entry points. Add tests for the merge order.

title: Add a token-bucket rate limiter to 5 endpoints
prompt: Implement a token-bucket rate limiter. Apply it to 5 endpoints with different rate configs per role. Add Redis-backed storage for distributed deployments. Add tests.

title: Add Redis cache to expensive endpoint + invalidate on write
prompt: Add a Redis cache to GET /reports/{id} (currently slow). Cache invalidation must trigger on any write to that report. Add a cache hit/miss metric. Add tests for cache hit, miss, and invalidation.

title: Add cursor-based pagination to /items
prompt: Add cursor-based pagination to GET /items. Update the OpenAPI spec. Update the SDK client. Update the frontend. Update tests. Ensure backwards compatibility with offset-based clients for 2 release cycles.

title: Add full-text search: schema, endpoint, frontend, docs
prompt: Add a full-text search feature: create a search_index table, add POST /search endpoint, build a simple frontend page, update the OpenAPI spec, add an SDK method, add tests for the endpoint, add a README section.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/search.md

title: Add webhook system: table, endpoint, signing, retries, dashboard
prompt: Add a webhook delivery system: webhooks table, POST /webhooks endpoint, HMAC signing, exponential backoff retries, a small dashboard page. Add tests. Update docs.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/webhooks.md

title: Add audit log: schema, capture, query, export, retention
prompt: Add an audit log: audit_log table, capture wrapper for mutating endpoints, GET /audit endpoint with filters, CSV export, 90-day retention job. Add tests. Update docs.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/audit.md

title: Add user data export: schema, job, download URL, retention
prompt: Add a user data export: exports table, POST /export endpoint, async job runner, signed download URL with 24h expiry, 7-day file retention. Add tests. Update docs.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/export.md

title: Add 2FA: TOTP setup, verification, recovery codes, admin reset
prompt: Add 2FA: TOTP setup endpoint, verification on login, 10 recovery codes per user, admin reset endpoint, all backed by a new totp_secrets table. Add tests. Update docs.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/2fa.md

title: Add soft delete: deleted_at column, query filters, restore, purge
prompt: Add soft delete to the User and Item models: deleted_at column, automatic filter on all queries, restore endpoint, 30-day purge job. Add tests. Update docs.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && test -f docs/soft-delete.md

title: Add deprecation shims to 6 legacy functions
prompt: Find 6 functions marked 'legacy' in their docstring. For each, add a DeprecationWarning at call time, route to the new function, and update callers. Keep the old name working for one release.
verify_command: python -W error::DeprecationWarning -c 'import pkg' 2>&1 | grep -c 'DeprecationWarning' | grep -q 6 && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Migrate 10 environment variable reads to typed config
prompt: Find 10 places that read os.environ directly. Replace each with a typed config field in config.py. Add validation. Update tests.
verify_command: ! grep -rn 'os.environ.get' src/ | grep -v 'config.py' | head -1 && python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -1
